eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Washington; at 1:03 PM on AUG 17, 2026 Effective until 2:03 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Washington State Patrol on behalf of Clark Co Sheriff's Office has issued an Amber Alert for a 7-Month-old. Victim is a 7-Month-old Male named Marcello Martinez. Victim is 24 inches tall, weighs 16 lbs, has brown hair, brown eyes, wearing a blue onesie saying "Grandma's are the best" in neon. They were last seen on 08-16-2026 05:00. They are in the company of Raul Martinez, a 37-year-old Male, who is 5 ft 6 inches, weighing 180 lbs with brown hair, brown eyes and wearing tight sweatpants, white shirt, and a blue/green jacket. There is no associated vehicle, but vehicle may have evidence tape on it. If you have information, please call 9 1 1.
